text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm, next is "one-on-one races." Ohhh, I
didn't know they put on these
kinds of
shows in past festivals.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I'd be able to figure out what
the Fleetfoot Festival means
to me by
learning more about it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Forgive me for interrupting your
reading, but can I make a
suggestion?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is only a personal opinion, but I
recommend reading the letter
excerpt on
page fifty-three.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Page fifty-three?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"After claiming the Satsuki Sho, I was
named the Umamusume who
dashed
toward the stars. But at the Derby, I froze
in front of a big
crowd and failed
miserably."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"At the Kikuka Sho, I tripped on the rough
turf, missing my chance to
win once again.
Even still, my fans chose me to run in the
Arima
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I vowed under the light of the Fleetfoot
Festival. I would not lose. I
absolutely,
definitely, certainly would not lose."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I was willing to risk it all going into that
race. Looking back, I think
that was a
necessary ritual for me at the time."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ritual...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Late autumn... A season full of
Umamusume burning bright with
passion
and determination. Have you ever
wondered why the
Fleetfoot Festival is
held then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For those running in the forefront, the
festival is a meaningful
milestone. A time
their determination is renewed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Curren is determined to fulfil her role as a
mascot. For Yukino,
festivals themselves
are important to her.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(So what about me? What am I dancing
for?)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(If I don't want to be a doll forever, I've
got to think of a way to pull
the strings
myself.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to carve my own path! I want to
show my dedication as a
racing
Umamusume with this ritual!

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text: Aaand stop! Not bad, not bad!

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
City, you've made a remarkable
improvement! Not only are your
moves
beautiful, but you have a self-assured
charm about you that I
can't take my eyes
off!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I should say... I'm sorry I wasn't
giving it my all until now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But I've made up my mind. I promise, I'm
going to do this right!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow... It's like City's unlocked a new
power! Guess I can't afford to sit
back
either!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Uh, Yukino? Heeey! You okay? You
haven't blinked in a while!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?! Uh, y-yes?! I...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sorry... It's just... City is so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each Umamusume continues practicing
diligently over the next few
days of the
camp...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay... It's look'n a lot better now. We're
going back tomorrow, so I
better start
gett'n my stuff together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...The training camp's already end'n... Then
when we get back to the
academy, we're
perform'n straight after.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(But I'm not sure if I'm good enough for it
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yukino! Yukinooo! It's an emergency!
Come to the community hall
right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wha—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the costumes! That means they
arrived, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! ♪ The URA made brand-new
costumes for us all! And it's not just
us
dancers—the archers get some too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They're all sooooo so cute! Come on, let's
go try them on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wah! Wait for me, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(New costumes... Putt'n me aside, I bet
they're gonna look so spiffy
on Curren and
City!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (So... glam'rous...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's comfortable to move in. I think
the length should be good
like this. Oh,
about the shoes...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (City... City's... so beautiful...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (She's so beautiful... too beautiful.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yukino! Your costume's here too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They wanna see how they all look
together, so put yours on so we can
line
up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...I have to go!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Huh? Yukino? What's wrong? Your
costume is back there with
City.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Curren... C-Curren, please! I'm begg'n you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Swap with me for the center part!
